record.original_question:
Let ψ ∈ L2(R). For integers j,k ∈ Z, define ψ_{j,k}(x) := 2^{j/2} ψ(2^j x − k). Call ψ a Parseval wavelet if ∑_{j,k∈Z} |⟨f, ψ_{j,k}⟩|^2 = ||f||^2 for all f ∈ L2(R).

Is the collection of Parseval wavelets path connected in the L2(R) norm?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $L^2(\mathbb{R})$ denote the Hilbert space of square-integrable complex-valued functions on $\mathbb{R}$ with the standard norm $\|\cdot\|_{L^2}$. For $\psi \in L^2(\mathbb{R})$ and integers $j,k \in \mathbb{Z}$, define the dyadic translation–dilation
$$\psi_{j,k}(x) := 2^{j/2}\,\psi(2^j x - k), \qquad x \in \mathbb{R}.$$
Call $\psi \in L^2(\mathbb{R})$ a Parseval wavelet if the system $\{\psi_{j,k} : j,k \in \mathbb{Z}\}$ is a Parseval frame for $L^2(\mathbb{R})$, i.e.
$$\sum_{j,k \in \mathbb{Z}} |\langle f, \psi_{j,k}\rangle|^2 = \|f\|_{L^2}^2 \qquad \text{for every } f \in L^2(\mathbb{R}).$$
Let $\mathcal{P} \subset L^2(\mathbb{R})$ be the set of all Parseval wavelets, equipped with the metric inherited from the $L^2(\mathbb{R})$ norm.

Question: Is $\mathcal{P}$ path connected? Equivalently, given any two Parseval wavelets $\psi_0, \psi_1 \in \mathcal{P}$, does there exist a continuous map $\gamma: [0,1] \to (L^2(\mathbb{R}), \|\cdot\|_{L^2})$ with $\gamma(0) = \psi_0$, $\gamma(1) = \psi_1$, and $\gamma(t) \in \mathcal{P}$ for all $t \in [0,1]$?
artifact.status_search_result: The connectivity question for Parseval wavelets is widely cited as open in its full generality. Partial positive results are known for restricted subclasses, including MSF (minimally supported frequency) Parseval wavelets, MRA Parseval wavelets, and Parseval wavelets satisfying spectral conditions; the general L^2-connectivity of all Parseval wavelets has not been resolved.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems in Wavelet Theory (M. Bownik)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing connectivity of Parseval wavelets among open problems, with partial results for MSF and MRA subclasses.
status_evidence.claim: The general path-connectivity of Parseval wavelets in L^2(R) is recognized as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Connectivity and density in the set of framelets
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes connectivity/density properties for framelets, leaving the general Parseval wavelet connectivity open.
status_evidence.claim: Partial connectivity results for related framelet classes are available, but the general Parseval case remains unresolved.
